text:
Complete resynthesis of phosphocreatine stores following maximal-intensity exercise typically requires approximately 3 to 5 minutes. This recovery time is heavily dependent on the intensity and duration of the preceding activity, with higher intensities prolonging the process due to greater depletion levels. Therefore, under normal conditions after very high effort, full restoration generally occurs within this short window before significant performance decline in subsequent efforts becomes a concern.

CONFIDENCE: 95
